findings.current: At first, I’d thought he was just a eunuch who’d spat a lot of phlegm in his younger days. Now, hearing this, I could almost see Hong Jin in the past, spitting in the corridors of the imperial palace.
findings.defect: The first reference to spitting is an idiom for having been a tough guy. Translating both references literally removes the shift to the image of Hong Jin spitting in the palace.
findings.rationale: 소싯적에 침 좀 뱉었던 describes a rough past; 황궁 복도에서 가래침을 뱉었을 turns that expression into a literal image.
findings.replacement: At first, I’d thought he was just a eunuch who’d been a bit of a tough guy in his youth. Now that I’d heard his story, I could almost picture him hawking up phlegm in the palace corridors.
findings.source: 처음에는 그저 소싯적에 침 좀 뱉었던 고자인 줄 알았는데, 이야기를 듣고 나니 황궁 복도에서 가래침을 뱉었을 홍진의 과거 모습이 눈앞을 스치는 듯했다.

findings.current: “Long live the prince! Long live the prince! Long, long live the prince!”
findings.defect: The ceremonial acclamation’s specified duration is replaced with a generic wish, obscuring its distinct royal wording.
findings.rationale: 천세 invokes a thousand years, repeated before the intensified 천천세.
findings.replacement: “A thousand years! A thousand years! A thousand thousand years!”

findings.current: “It’s been a long time, Hong, Deputy Commissioner. Or should I call you Deputy Military Commissioner now?”
findings.defect: The draft invents “Deputy Commissioner” for 첩형, blurring the contrast between Hong Jin’s former East Depot title and his present office.
findings.rationale: The old eunuch first addresses Hong by the distinct title 첩형, then pointedly switches to 도지휘동지.
findings.replacement: “It’s been a long time, Hong Cheophyeong. Or should I call you Deputy Military Commissioner now?”
findings.source: “오랜만이오, 홍 첩형(貼刑). 아니, 이제는 도지휘동지라고 불러 드리면 될까.”

findings.current: “So it changed. So what? And you must be getting old enough for your brain to have hardened. It’s been eleven years and nine days, to be precise.”
findings.defect: “So what?” concedes change and dismisses its importance; Hong’s retort doubts how much could have changed.
findings.rationale: 변해 봤자지 뭐 pushes back against the old eunuch’s warning that more than the landscape has changed.
findings.replacement: “Things can only change so much. And your brain must have gone stiff with age. It’s been eleven years and nine days, to be precise.”
findings.source: “변해 봤자지 뭐. 그리고 늙어서 머리가 굳은 모양인데, 정확히는 십일 년 하고도 아흐레야.”

findings.current: “Time does pass. His Highness Prince Shangshan gave his permission, and you have the nerve to question it? And…”
findings.defect: The retort drops Hong’s pointed “someone like you,” weakening his assertion of hierarchy over the old eunuch.
findings.rationale: 네놈 따위가 makes the eunuch’s presumption, not merely his disagreement, the insult.
findings.replacement: “Times really have changed. Someone like you dares to question something His Highness Prince Shangshan permitted? And…”
findings.source: “세월이 흐르긴 했네. 상산왕 전하께서 허락하신 일에 감히 네놈 따위가 왈가왈부하다니. 그리고…….”

findings.current: “Who the hell told you to draw your weapon? And in front of a child—no, with His Highness Prince Shangshan watching, too.”
findings.defect: “Too” can make the child and Prince Shangshan sound like two separate witnesses. Jin is correcting his informal description of the same person.
findings.rationale: 어린애, 아니 상산왕 전하 is an immediate self-correction in the prince’s presence.
findings.replacement: “Who the hell told you to draw your weapon? With a child—no, with His Highness Prince Shangshan watching, no less.”
findings.source: “어디서 함부로 병장기를 뽑고 지랄이냐. 그것도 어린애, 아니 상산왕 전하께서도 지켜보고 계시는 마당에.”

findings.current: Even I, who’d only been watching until then, frowned at the way he’d put it. But Hong Jin, Prince Shangshan’s loyal servant, reacted differently from before.
findings.defect: “Only been watching until then” implies Jin had remained a bystander up to this point, despite having just stopped a guard from drawing his sword.
findings.rationale: 우선은 limits Jin’s watching to the current exchange, not the whole confrontation.
findings.replacement: Even I, who was only watching for the moment, couldn’t help frowning. But Hong Jin, Prince Shangshan’s loyal servant, reacted differently from before.
findings.source: 우선은 그저 지켜만 보고 있던 나로서도 눈살이 찌푸려질 정도였지만, 상산왕의 충복인 홍진의 반응은 조금 전과 달랐다.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but several lines change the source’s joke, ceremonial wording, former title, or immediate scene details.
